Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco’s Customer Experience (CX) Engineering organization is a global team of engineers, architects, product leaders, and AI/ML experts building next-generation AI-powered experiences and capabilities through Cisco IQ, our industry-leading platform-centric approach. Our work plays a critical role in transforming how Cisco delivers customer and partner experiences by applying Generative AI, AI/ML, intelligent agents, automation, and data-driven insights at enterprise scale. We are a highly collaborative, customer-focused team that combines the agility and innovation mindset of an incubation organization with the scale, engineering rigor, and reach of Cisco. Team members work across disciplines to solve complex technical challenges and turn emerging AI technologies into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of AI-powered Customer Experience at Cisco and build capabilities that can create meaningful impact for customers, partners, and internal teams worldwide.
  
  
Your Impact
  
In this role, you will architect, build, and scale enterprise-grade AI/ML and Generative AI solutions—including predictive models, RAG architectures, and autonomous agentic workflows—that power Cisco IQ and our next-generation Customer Experience platform. Operating across the full machine learning lifecycle, you will own robust data pipelines, low-latency model serving, and LLMOps infrastructure while establishing rigorous automated evaluation and observability frameworks to ensure high-accuracy, reliable performance at scale. You will partner with product managers, data scientists, and software engineering teams to translate complex business needs into secure, production-ready capabilities, driving technical excellence, responsible AI governance, and measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree with 7+ years related experience, or Masters degree with 4+ years related experience.
* Programming experience using Python and/or Java, including designing, developing, testing, and deploying production-grade software applications, APIs, and/or distributed services.
* AI/ML experience developing, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, or equivalent technologies.
* Generative AI/LLM development experience, including building applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings/vector databases, prompt engineering, AI agents, and/or LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangChain/LangGraph, LangSmith, OpenAI or Anthropic/Claude APIs, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience building data pipelines and data-intensive applications using technologies such as SQL, Spark, Kafka, ETL/ELT frameworks, cloud data platforms, or equivalent data engineering technologies.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Hands-on experience designing and building Generative AI and agentic AI applications, including RAG, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and context management using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with LLMOps/MLOps and AI evaluation/observability, including tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, model monitoring, automated evaluation frameworks, and techniques for measuring model quality, accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Experience building and deploying cloud-native AI/ML applications and data platforms using AWS, or Google Cloud, along with technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, REST APIs, microservices, CI/CD, and modern data processing frameworks.
* Proficiency with modern AI-assisted software engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude/Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to accelerate development, testing, debugging, code reviews, and engineering productivity.
* Demonstrated ability to independently own complex technical problems, collaborate across engineering, product, architecture, and data science teams, communicate technical concepts effectively, and mentor other engineers while delivering high-quality production solutions.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

**Job Description**

**About the role:**
-------------------

As a Simulation AI/ML Engineer intern, you’ll partner with senior engineers to deliver key components of the evaluation strategy for GM’s autonomous vehicle programs. In this role, you will scale the testing and evaluation of our self-driving stack by applying AI/ML techniques to software solutions. You will design, perform experiments, and deploy these solutions as production-ready code. The work you do will be directly applied to the iteration and validation of the self-driving stack.

**About the team:**
-------------------

The GM AV Simulation team builds world-class testing and analysis related products and technologies to enable GM to accelerate the development of autonomous vehicles as well as general vehicle software development. Our customers range from AV developers understanding the effects of their code on vehicle behavior, data engineers using our data pipelines to generate meaningful insights for various evaluation needs, to the release team tracking top-line performance metrics on releases. AV Simulation aims to deliver intuitive user experiences for robotics and AI engineers that accelerate GM towards a driverless future.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* Leverage AI/ML techniques to scale testing, classify autonomy performance, and mine critical scenarios, integrating human-in-the-loop where appropriate.
* Collaborate with engineers to integrate ML models into simulation tests and evaluation pipelines.
* Ramp up quickly on the codebase and domain; deliver assigned tasks efficiently with few iterations.
* Develop, test, and deploy production-ready code across components of our simulation infrastructure.
* Define problem statements and implement optimal, tradeoff-aware solutions that cover edge cases.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, contribute to design and code reviews, and ensure seamless integration through clear communication.  

  
  

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, robotics, engineering, or a related STEM field.
* Must have at least one additional quarter/semester of school remaining following the completion of the internship
* Solid understanding of modern machine learning techniques
* Demonstrated coursework, research, or projects in AI/ML.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
Able to work full-time, 40 hours per week.

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Every time Claude runs code, uses a computer, or works as an agent, it does so inside a sandbox. Our Sandboxing team builds the isolation layer behind that work. The same systems run the code Claude writes for users, the environments we train and evaluate models in, and the agents our customers deploy.

These workloads are untrusted by design, and there are a lot of them. Sandboxes need to start in milliseconds, hold up under adversarial code, and scale to a very large number of concurrent sessions. You will work at the boundary between the Linux kernel, virtualization, and the container ecosystem. You will partner with research, product, and security teams to make sure that safe and fast do not trade off against each other.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, build, and operate the sandboxing infrastructure that runs untrusted, model-generated code and agent workloads at scale
* Improve sandbox startup time, density, and throughput, including snapshot and restore, checkpointing, and warm pools
* Strengthen isolation across compute, filesystem, and network, including egress controls and per-session credential handling
* Investigate and fix performance, reliability, and security issues at the kernel, hypervisor, and container runtime level
* Build the monitoring, tracing, and debugging tools that show where time and resources go inside a sandbox
* Work with researchers to support reinforcement learning environments and evaluations that need fast, reproducible, isolated execution
* Work with product and platform engineers to expose sandboxes as a dependable, well-designed capability for Claude products and customers
* Partner with security teams to threat-model the platform and to test, harden, and respond to escape and abuse scenarios
* Work with cloud providers on the hardware and platform features that our workloads depend on
* Share knowledge on systems programming and Linux internals, and help set technical standards for the team

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Software engineering experience in Linux systems programming, kernel development, or another low-level area
* Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as Rust, C, C++, or Go
* Working knowledge of virtualization or container isolation technologies such as KVM, QEMU, Firecracker, gVisor, or runc
* Understanding of Linux resource management, including namespaces, cgroups, scheduling, and memory management
* Experience profiling and debugging performance issues at the system level
* Ability to work in unfamiliar codebases and technical areas, and to ship practical solutions with measurable results
* Strong communication skills and a commitment to building safe, reliable systems

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience building or operating a multi-tenant sandbox, serverless, or code execution platform
* Experience with microVMs, user-space kernels, or lightweight virtualization, including snapshot and restore
* Experience with OS-level security hardening, including seccomp, LSMs, and threat modeling of untrusted code
* Experience with eBPF and kernel tracing tools
* Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure at scale (AWS, GCP)
* Experience with network isolation, high-performance networking, or building egress proxies and policy layers
* Experience with sandboxes for AI agents, computer use, or reinforcement learning environments
* Experience with GPU virtualization, accelerators, or performance work on machine learning workloads
* Prior experience as a technical lead or mentor

**Representative projects**
---------------------------

* Cutting sandbox cold start from seconds to milliseconds with snapshot-based restore and pre-warmed pools
* Designing a network egress policy layer so agents can reach approved services without exposing secrets
* Running many thousands of parallel reinforcement learning environments with strong isolation between them
* Building tracing tools that attribute latency and resource use inside a running sandbox
* Reducing per-sandbox memory overhead to raise density on each host
* Hardening the runtime against escape attempts found in internal red-team exercises
